item.description:
Apple Silicon (arm64), macOS 14 or later. This release uses Apple development signing. macOS may block first launch because the app has not been notarized by Apple.
- Switch viewing profiles from a compact three-column menu with avatars, an active profile indicator, and shortcuts to profile management and settings. - Choose which playlists each new profile can use. - Copy favorites and watch history from the previous profile for the selected playlists on first entry. Continue browsing while the import finishes. - See a restoring screen while switching profiles. - Improve startup recovery for saved playlist connections.
